name: project-designer
conclusion_quantitative: project-designer (Ask) specifies 1 of 5 categories: 3 clarification rules; none for autonomy limits, approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.
conclusion_qualitative: project-designer turns an initial project idea into a well-architected design with technology recommendations, prioritized features and documentation. Its only control rules are about asking clarifying questions when the idea is unclear. It sets no approval gates, autonomy limits, checks on its own work or rules for handling failure.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never forbids or restricts any action of the agent on files, commands, tools or other systems, and never tells it to go ahead without asking.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 3 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent asks clarifying questions through `AskUserQuestion` when the project scope is ambiguous, several architectures are viable, or requirements or user needs are unclear.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
